messages:
maria: quick design review — got a handful of alpha users flagging the token meter UX + stop/regenerate placement. posting notes and observed behavior here. kevin: can you paste the spots? is it that the meter hides the exact count? mar ia: they said meter is helpful but hover currently just shows 'tokens' not a breakdown. also hover opening causes the streaming line to jump a px — looks buggy on retina. kevin: ok. proposal: on hover show breakdown: message tokens, prompt library tokens, session total. show approximate label. also add small 'copy' icon to export to prompt library. sam: implementation heads-up: hovercard on streaming node triggers reflow because we switch from inline to absolute. we can avoid layout shift by reserving the hover space and rendering an absolutely-positioned overlay with transform. but that blocks pointer events while streaming. ali: usability note: people try to stop the stream quickly. telemetry shows 40% of stop clicks land on the token meter by accident because it overlaps the stop button on narrow windows. suggest: increase spacing or move stop into message actions (kebab). olga: accessibility nits: hover-only interactions are not keyboard accessible. hovercard must be reachable with Tab, use role="dialog" or role="tooltip" with aria-describedby. streaming updates need an aria-live region for token counts, and users with reduced motion should not get flashy animations. kevin: +1 on aria-live. microcopy idea for hovercard header: "Estimated token usage — may change after model truncation". shorter: "Estimated tokens (approx.)". thoughts? maria: keep it short. maybe: "Estimated tokens — may vary". also keep the stop/regenerate visible (not buried) because PMs want 1-click stop. sam: compromise: keep stop visible but move regenerate to kebab. Make stop a solid primary icon (easy hit target). regen is destructive-ish so kebab seems fine. ali: mobile: large touch targets for stop (44px). also ensure the hovercard idea degrades to a tap-to-open detail panel on mobile. olga: code snippet for reduced-motion + aria example I can share: ```css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .stream-spinner { animation: none; } } ``` and ```html
Streaming — 120 tokens
``` kevin: love that. Also we should add keyboard shortcut: Escape to stop streaming, documented in tooltip and keyboard guide. maria: one microcopy tweak request: change "Stop generation" -> "Stop output" (shorter and used in alpha feedback). sam: on perf: avoiding layout thrash reduces frame drops by ~15% on our perf tests. I'll prototype overlay approach and test with 512 tokens streaming. kevin: I'll put together a quick mock for hovercard states (collapsed, hover, keyboard focus, mobile tap-panel) by EOD. ali: I'll draft the prompt-library copy/export flow and the copy icon affordance. olga: I'll run a quick keyboard walkthrough and collate a11y issues. deploy-bot: playground v2 staging deployed (sha: 3a7bf). :rocket: maria: plan next steps: 1) kevin mock, 2) sam perf PR, 3) ali copy flow, 4) olga keyboard/a11y check, 5) quick 3-user usability test next week. tagging owners in the PR. :thumbsup:
